finalText:
Ran clean except for two, both in `auth/tokens.test.js`. 698 of 700 tests passed.

The two failures:
1. `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — `auth/tokens.test.js:400`
2. `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — `auth/tokens.test.js:650`

Both point at token/session handling, worth a look before the next deploy.
